# GNK ASG Readiness Check

Status: locked preparation.

## Rule

Do not show unfinished work on the public portal.

## Before any new public module is enabled

- Existing pages must continue to work.
- Main navigation must stay clean.
- No empty page may be linked.
- No unfinished button may be visible.
- Each new page must have a title, description and working links.
- Each image must have a clear purpose and alt text.
- Main story must remain GNK ASG and GNK DINAMO Ltd.
- The personal layer must stay accurate and discreet.
- New content must be useful, professional and safe.
- First release should be reviewed before scheduled operation.

## First controlled release

1. Prepare content.
2. Prepare image.
3. Check links.
4. Check mobile view.
5. Check metadata.
6. Review final public appearance.
7. Enable only the finished module.

## Long-term rule

Build everything in preparation first. Wake the system only when it is complete.
